intro.name: The trial
intro.text: Two experienced villagers demand a tournament to decide whose discipline best protects the village. Blunted wooden weapons, padded shields, and a healer stand ready.

choices.label: Replace combat with demonstrations of defense and restraint.

a1.text: The veteran wins every bout, then offers to teach the defeated apprentice. The crowd cheers louder for the lesson than for the victory.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

a2.text: A quiet farmer defeats the favored warrior with a clever feint. The favorite demands a rematch, but the judges uphold the result.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

a3.text: A contestant loses control and strikes too hard. The judges stop the tournament; the offender must apologize and help the healer.

a4.text: Two finalists refuse to yield. They agree to share the prize and train the village together.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

b1.text: The contestants demonstrate disarming, retreating, and protecting children. The judges declare that courage need not require injury.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience

narrative: the contest avoids injury; nobody is hurt

b2.text: The crowd complains that the contest is boring until a mock ambush reveals the champion's extraordinary vigilance.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives food

b3.text: One boastful fighter fails to defend a basket of coconuts from three giggling children. Nobody lets (boaster.him/her) forget it.

p1.text: A judge from the other community praises the winning rival despite pressure from (judge.his/her) own supporters. The crowd slowly applauds.

p2.text: An accusation of favoritism forces the judges to disclose their criteria; the disputed result is upheld, reversed, or declared a tie.

p3.text: Competitors from both communities secretly practice together and publicly acknowledge each other when the results are announced.
